description: Connecticut: commercial, industrial and apartment parcels from the OPM GIS Office statewide 'Connecticut CAMA and Parcel Layer' (CC0; town CAMA attributes), for the FactLot Registry collector. Supersedes the gated Socrata review ct-parcel-cama for the licence question. See docs/registry/sources/ct-parcel-cama-layer.md.

sources.publisher: Connecticut Office of Policy and Management, GIS Office (data collected from the towns through the Councils of Governments)
sources.license: CC0 (licenseInfo of the ArcGIS item 'Connecticut CAMA and Parcel Layer', published by the Connecticut OPM GIS Office, owner ctgisoffice; the same licence is set on the office's 'Connecticut State Parcel Layer 2023', 'Connecticut Public Use Parcels', 'Connecticut Vacant Parcels' and 'Parcel Viewer' items). The Open Data CT (Socrata) copy of the same data carries no licence field, which is why ct-parcel-cama was gated; the publisher's own CC0 statement on the ArcGIS items resolves that. Underlying records are the towns' grand lists (C.G.S. 12-55, public)
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; CC0 does not restrict it
sources.redistribution: Permitted (CC0 1.0 public-domain dedication). Attribution not required; credit the Connecticut Office of Policy and Management GIS Office and the towns
sources.notes: ArcGIS Online item 82a733423a244c43a9d4bf552954cea9 'Connecticut CAMA and Parcel Layer' (owner ctgisoffice, modified 2026-10-13), feature service services3.arcgis.com/3FL1kr7L4LvwA2Kb/arcgis/rest/services/Connecticut_CAMA_and_Parcel_Layer/FeatureServer/0 (maxRecordCount 2,000): the 2026 parcel collection joined to the towns' CAMA reports, 169 towns, 1,320,686 records (the Open Data CT table ibe8-9i3q of ct-parcel-cama has 1,359,259 rows). The files are 29 pages (OBJECTID order, geometry off) of the 57,855 records with a building value (Appraised_Building > 0) whose State_Use_Description contains one of 22 commercial words (COMM, INDUS, APART, APT, OFFICE, STORE, SHOP, RETAIL, WAREH, WHSE, WHS, MANUF, MFG, HOTEL, MOTEL, BANK, RESTAUR, AUTO, GAS, MALL, PLAZA, STORAGE); the adapter then maps only descriptions whose own words say commercial, industrial or apartment of five or more units (about 150 normalized descriptions; land, vacant, exempt, mixed-use, residential-with-apartment descriptions are not mapped). State_Use is each town's own code; the same code means different things in different towns, so codes are never used. The county FIPS is the layer's former county (FIPS field, characters 3-5); Connecticut's counties were replaced by planning regions for Census purposes in 2022. Owner and mailing address are present; blank where the town suppresses them. robots.txt: services3.arcgis.com serves none the collector could read as rules; www.arcgis.com is used for the item JSON only.
